acceptanceCriteria: A test with more directories than the per-pass bound proves every eligible directory is retired within a stated number of passes.
Per-pass CPU and I/O stay within the existing bound.
body:
Found 2026-10-07 by the V1-0930/V1-0931 delivery lane (branch claude/cleanup-tasks, head 73a42cf2, based on batch 4 head 5808c26c) and retained by the orchestrator as a known limit of that delivery.

Documented limit. One retirement pass scans at most 4,096 dispatcher worker directories and 1,024 attempt directories (CAL-V0-144 / ATR-V0-015, proposed). With a larger backlog, the same first entries can be rescanned every pass and later ones are never reached.

Expected: a resume cursor (or rotating start) so every directory is eventually visited within the per-pass bound.
title: Worker and run retirement scans stop at 4,096 / 1,024 directories per pass, so a larger backlog can starve
